title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content:
举父站在原地困惑地挠了挠头，最终半蹲下身，朝陆白伸出了手。“这应该是表示友好的手势吧？”陆白心里有些不确定地想着，还是跳了上去。半个小时后。咚！咚咚！！站在举父肩膀上，跟着它一起巡视着整座崇吾山。陆白体会到了当山大王的快乐。崇吾山上的各种物产资源基本上都是任他予取予求。其中让陆白印象最为深刻的，是一种长得很像橘子，名为枳实的水果。即使以他现在的身体素质，吃下一枚这东西之后，也有一种全身上下燥热无比的感觉。好在这种感觉并没有持续太久。在陆白跳进水潭中泡了半小时后，体温重新恢复正常。而这么一圈吃下来，他因为举父的天赋能力大幅度增强的身体素质，竟然再度增长了接近三分之一。“难怪都说山海经是食谱，这里简直太快乐了。”最后撑得实在吃不下的陆白，跟举父一起坐在崇吾山的山巅之上，欣赏着缓缓落下的夕阳。知道举父能够听懂自己话的陆白，随口问了个话题。“举父，这座崇吾山上只有你一头异兽吗？”举父缓缓摇了摇头，抬手指了指远处泛着红光的云霞，朝那吼了一声。“戾！！”似乎是在回应举父的呼唤一样，云霞之中，飞出来一头青红二色的神异比翼鸟。白泽精怪图再次亮了起来。一套熟悉的拓印流程过后，白泽精怪图之中储存的愿力再次减少了三分之一。而陆白又多出了一项天赋能力。【森罗lv1】一股不同于刚才的冰冷寒意同时作用于他的双眼和大脑。

陆白的精神力在这一刻瞬间爆增。泛着红色光芒的双眼仿佛能看透人心，催眠精神力低于他的生物，也能制造出真实的幻像。“戾戾？？？”感受到陆白身上升起的熟悉气息，刚从云霞中飞出的比翼鸟，也露出了跟刚才举父一样的疑惑表情。.......血腥玛丽酒吧！昏暗的走廊里响起一阵略显杂乱的脚步声，时间似乎距离陆白离开并没有过去多久。不过这一次。在陆白重新推门走出来的时候，情况已经完全不同。那些手里拿着枪的帮派分子大声呼喊‘快，那小子就在这里’，然后朝身边的同伴开枪。砰！砰砰！！伴随着一朵朵象征罪恶的血花绽开，陆白在灯光昏暗的走廊里漫步前行。而他身后的人群依次向两边倒下。“不，这不可能！！”酒吧顶层的办公室里，一名壮得像是黑熊、脖子上纹着黑色手枪纹身的中年黑人，通过监控屏幕看到这一幕，惊得豁然站起了身。在他的视角里。这些手下就跟集体磕了药似的，向着身边的同伴疯狂开枪。而那个他按照金主吩咐绑来的亚裔小子，全身上下都透露着一股不对劲。这让在监狱里一手创立了弗里曼手枪党，并且将它慢慢发展成现在占据了纽约十几条街区黑帮的弗里曼，从内心深处升起一股寒意。甚至同样在办公室里的两名心腹手下，第一次在如同黑熊般血腥残忍的弗里曼脸上看到恐惧的情绪。“我们马上走，这里不能待下去了。”弗里曼匆匆在办公桌下面拿出一把手枪，就准备离开这里。这个亚裔小子绝对是来自东方的邪恶巫师，普通人不是他的对手。“你想去哪里呢，我亲爱的朋友。”这时候，从后脑勺上传来的金属冰冷触感，让弗里曼止住了自己从办公室暗门离开的动作。
content_en:
Ju's father stood there and scratched his head in confusion, and finally squatted down and stretched out his hand towards Lu Bai."This should be a friendly gesture, right?" Lu Bai thought with some uncertainty, but still jumped up.Half an hour later.Boom!Boom!!Standing on Ju's father's shoulders, he patrolled the entire Chongwu Mountain with him.Lu Bai experienced the joy of being the king of the mountain.The various physical resources on Chongwu Mountain are basically at his disposal.Among them, the one that impressed Lu Bai the most was a fruit that looked like an orange, called Zhishi.Even with his current physical condition, after eating one of these things, he would feel extremely hot all over his body.Fortunately, this feeling did not last long.After Lu Bai jumped into the pool and soaked for half an hour, his body temperature returned to normal.After such a round of eating, his physical fitness, which had been greatly enhanced due to his father's talent, actually increased by nearly one-third again."No wonder they say the Classic of Mountains and Seas is a recipe. It's so happy here." Lu Bai, who finally couldn't eat anymore, sat on the top of Chongwu Mountain with his father, admiring the slowly setting sun.Lu Bai, knowing that his father could understand his words, casually asked a topic."Ju's father, are you the only strange beast on this Chongwu Mountain?" Ju's father shook his head slowly, raised his finger and pointed at the red-glowing clouds in the distance, and roared towards it."Violent!!" As if in response to his father's call, a green and red magical bird flew out from the clouds.Bai Ze's ghost picture lit up again.After a familiar set of rubbing processes, the will power stored in Bai Ze's ghost map was once again reduced by one-third.And Lu Bai has another innate ability.[Senluo lv1] A different icy coldness than before acted on his eyes and brain at the same time.

Lu Bai's mental power instantly increased at this moment.The glowing red eyes seem to be able to see through people's hearts, and they can hypnotize creatures with lower mental power than him and create real illusions."Violent???" Sensing the familiar aura rising from Lu Bai's body, the winged bird that had just flown out of the clouds also showed the same puzzled expression as Ju's father just now........Bloody Mary Bar!There was a burst of slightly chaotic footsteps in the dim corridor, and it seemed that not long had passed since Lu Bai left.But this time.When Lu Bai opened the door again and walked out, the situation was completely different.The gang members with guns in their hands shouted, "Quick, that kid is here," and then shot at their companions.Bang!Bang bang!!As blood flowers symbolizing sin bloomed, Lu Bai walked in the dimly lit corridor.The crowd behind him fell to both sides one after another."No, this is impossible!!" In the office on the top floor of the bar, a middle-aged black man who was as strong as a black bear and had a black pistol tattoo on his neck saw this scene through the surveillance screen and stood up suddenly in shock.From his perspective.These men seemed to have taken drugs collectively, shooting wildly at their companions around them.As for the Asian boy he kidnapped at the behest's order, there was something wrong about him.This gave Freeman, who founded the Freeman Pistol Gang in prison and slowly developed it into a gang that now occupies more than a dozen neighborhoods in New York, a chill in his heart.Even the two henchmen who were also in the office saw fear for the first time on the face of Freeman, who was as bloody and cruel as a black bear."We're leaving now, we can't stay here any longer." Freeman hurriedly took out a pistol under his desk and prepared to leave.This Asian boy is definitely an evil wizard from the East, and ordinary people are no match for him."Where do you want to go, my dear friend." At this time, the cold touch of metal coming from the back of his head made Freeman stop leaving from the secret door of the office.
